title: CORR-003: Document endpoint path consistency
description: The API endpoint path changed from /api/admin/installer to /downloads/installer. However, downloadBootstrapScript() still uses /api/admin/bootstrap.ps1. These should be consistent or have documented reasons for differences. Adding clear comments explains the endpoint strategy.

context.goal: Add comments explaining why different paths are used

acceptance_criteria: Add comment before downloadInstaller() explaining /downloads/ path is for static files
Add comment before downloadBootstrapScript() explaining /api/admin/ path is for API-served scripts
Comments are clear and explain the distinction
Comments are at same indentation level as code for readability
Pattern is documented for future developers

implementation_notes.pattern_note: This documents the current architecture choice. If paths should be consolidated in future, this comment makes the reasoning clear.

code_review: Verify comments are present and accurate
Check comments explain difference between /downloads/ and /api/admin/ paths
documentation_check: Read comments as a new developer would
Verify explanation makes sense and is actionable
Confirm comments are at appropriate detail level

rollback_plan: git revert <commit-hash> — comment-only change, safe to revert
notes: This is a documentation fix that clarifies architectural decisions. No code logic changes. Comments should be maintainer-friendly and explain 'why' not just 'what'.
